authorization_rule: Preferences rank only the set for which every applicable hard predicate is valid; they never enter authorizedAt or promote invalid or unavailable plans.

predicates.definition: Rank valid plans by the lowest total authorized fee without changing fee bounds.
predicates.evaluation_state: Evaluate only after all applicable hard predicates return valid.
predicates.external_premise: Ranking inputs are comparable only among plans already authorized by hard predicates.
predicates.residual_behavior: A preference neither creates nor authorizes a residual intent.
predicates.composition_rule: Preferences compose only as a declared deterministic ordering over the hard-valid candidate set.
